name: Donatico – Stripe Donations & Recurring Giving
author: forgeo.dev

sections.description:
Donatico is the independent alternative to GiveWP: a clean WordPress plugin for accepting donations via Stripe, with no platform fee on any tier and none of the weight of an all-in-one fundraising suite. No bloat, no page-builder dependency, no account on someone else’s platform – just donation forms on your own site, funds in your own Stripe account.

Already running GiveWP or Charitable? Donatico’s built-in importer migrates your donors, donation history, and campaign links in a few clicks – dry-run preview before anything is written, and re-running it never creates duplicate donors.

Perfect for non-profits, charities, churches, content creators, podcasters, and any organisation that wants a simple, professional donation system without platform fees or vendor lock-in.

Free Features

  • Migrate From GiveWP, Charitable, or CSV – Import your existing donors, donation history, and campaign links with a dry-run preview before anything is written; re-running an import never creates duplicates
  • Stripe Checkout Integration – Secure, Stripe-hosted payment page; card details never touch your server. The default payment mode.
  • On-Site Payment Form (Stripe Elements) – Optional alternative to the Checkout redirect: donors pay right on your page without leaving your site. Card details still never touch your server. Switch modes anytime in Donatico -> Settings -> Stripe.
  • Apple Pay & Google Pay – Enabled automatically in Checkout mode, no setup required. Available in Elements mode too, after a one-time domain registration in your Stripe dashboard.
  • 3 Form Layouts – Inline, Stacked, and Card designs
  • 6 Shortcodes – Forms, total raised, donation count, recent donors, progress bar, and an on-site donor history dashboard
  • Donor Dashboard – Donors request a secure email link to view their own giving history and print receipts, no account required
  • Offline Donations – Record cash, check, and bank-transfer gifts from the admin dashboard; they count toward totals and CSV export like any online gift
  • Fee Recovery – Optional “cover the processing fee” checkbox so more of each gift reaches your cause
  • Beautiful Email Notifications – Admin alerts and donor thank-you emails with merge tags
  • Donation Dashboard – Total raised, donation count, average amount, monthly stats, correct even across multiple currencies
  • Donation Management – Full list with status filters, search, and bulk delete, plus a per-donation detail view
  • CSV Export – Download your full donation history as a CSV file
  • Google Analytics 4 – Optional Measurement ID setting; fires a donation event on the thank-you page with the correct amount and currency
  • Form Designer – Live preview of form layouts and amounts
  • Multi-Currency – All major currencies supported by Stripe, including zero-decimal currencies like JPY and KRW
  • Goal Tracking – Animated progress bar with configurable goal amount
  • Custom Amounts – Preset amount buttons plus free-text custom amount input
  • Anonymous Donations – Optional anonymity checkbox for donors
  • Webhook Handling – Automatic status updates (completed, failed, refunded)
  • QR Scan-to-Donate – Generate a QR code for any donation page URL from Donatico -> QR Codes, downloadable as PNG or SVG
  • Sticky Donate Button – Optional floating donate button on every page, dismissible, with a configurable link and label
  • Mobile Responsive – Looks great on all screen sizes
  • Lightweight – No jQuery dependency on the frontend
  • GDPR Friendly – Minimal data collection; no third-party tracking

Donatico Pro – Turn one-time gifts into recurring support

The free plugin handles one-time donations beautifully. Donatico Pro adds the features that turn casual giving into dependable, recurring income:

  • Recurring Donations – Let supporters give monthly or yearly through Stripe. Predictable income that renews automatically – the backbone of sustainable fundraising.
  • Campaigns with Goals – Run fundraising drives with goal tracking and live progress, including a countdown to your end date, milestone badges at 25/50/75/100% of goal, and matching challenges – set a ratio, sponsor name, and an optional cap so your progress bar shows the sponsor-matched total alongside what’s been raised.
  • Donation Tiers – Offer named giving levels with perks to guide donors toward meaningful gifts.
  • Donor Management – See lifetime giving, history, and last gift for every supporter, right inside WordPress.
  • Tribute Gifts & Donor Wall – Accept donations in memory or honor of someone, and showcase supporters publicly.
  • Subscriber Self-Service Portal – Donors manage their own recurring gifts through a secure, email-verified portal.
  • Custom Form Fields – Add your own fields (text, textarea, dropdown, checkbox, or hidden) to your donation form; values show on each donation’s detail view and in CSV export.

Learn more and compare plans at donatico.forgeo.dev.

Donatico Business – Formal receipts and giving statements

Donatico Business is a higher tier than Starter, adding paperwork-grade documentation on top of everything in Pro:

  • PDF Donation Receipts – Each donation gets a downloadable PDF receipt with its own sequential receipt number, separate from the donation’s internal record ID.
  • Annual Giving Statements – Donors download one PDF summarizing all of their donations for a calendar year, right from their donor dashboard – shown separately per currency for donors who gave in more than one.
  • Organization Details on Receipts – Add your organization’s name, address, and tax ID/EIN so receipts and statements carry your official information.
  • Outbound Webhooks – Notify your own systems (Zapier, a custom app, your CRM) via a signed HTTP POST whenever a donation completes, a donor gives for the first time, a subscription starts or cancels, or a campaign hits its goal. Every delivery is HMAC-SHA256 signed, retried automatically on failure, and logged.
  • Funds / Designations – Let donors choose which fund or program their gift supports from a dropdown on your donation form. See per-fund totals – shown separately per currency for funds that received gifts in more than one – from a dedicated Funds admin page, and the designated fund on every donor receipt, dashboard entry, admin donation detail view, and CSV export row.
  • Tribute eCards – Turn a tribute gift into a shareable, downloadable PDF card with the honoree’s name and message – available from the donor dashboard alongside the regular PDF receipt for any donation made in memory or honor of someone.

Learn more and compare plans at donatico.forgeo.dev.

Quick Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Donatico -> Settings -> Stripe
  3. Enter your Stripe API keys (test or live)
  4. Add the [donatico_form] shortcode to any page or post
  5. Start accepting donations!

Shortcodes

Donation form:
[donatico_form]
[donatico_form layout=”card” amounts=”10,25,100″ title=”Support Us” button_text=”Donate Now”]

Parameters: layout (inline|stacked|card), amounts (comma-separated), title, description, button_text, show_message (yes|no), allow_anonymous (yes|no), goal (amount).

Widgets:
[donatico_total_raised] – Displays total amount raised
[donatico_donation_count] – Displays number of completed donations
[donatico_recent_donors limit=”5″] – Lists recent donors
[donatico_progress_bar goal=”5000″] – Animated goal progress bar

Donor dashboard:
[donatico_donor_dashboard] – Donors enter their email to request a secure, single-use link and view their own donation history and receipts on-site. No account or login required.

Email Notifications

Donatico sends two types of emails:

  • Admin notification – Sent to the configured admin email on every completed donation
  • Donor thank-you – Sent to the donor with a receipt and your customised message

Both support merge tags: {donor_name}, {amount}, {date}, {site_name}, and more. Customise everything in Settings -> Notifications.

External Services

This plugin connects to Stripe to process payments.

What it does:
Processes credit card donations via Stripe Checkout – a secure, Stripe-hosted payment page.

When it connects:
Only when a donor submits the donation form, or when Stripe sends a webhook event to confirm payment status.

What data is sent to Stripe:
Donor name, email address, donation amount, currency, and an optional message. Payment card details are entered directly on Stripe’s servers and never pass through your website.

Stripe links:

  • Service: https://stripe.com
  • Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins -> Add New
  2. Search for “Donatico”
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Configure under Donatico -> Settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload and extract to /wp-content/plugins/donatico/
  3. Activate through the Plugins screen
  4. Configure under Donatico -> Settings

After Activation

  1. Go to Donatico -> Settings -> Stripe
  2. Enter your Stripe Test Secret Key and Test Publishable Key
  3. Click Test Connection to verify
  4. Create a page and add [donatico_form]
  5. When ready for live donations, switch to Live mode and enter your live keys
sections.faq:
Do I need a Stripe account?

Yes. Sign up for free at stripe.com to get your API keys. You can accept donations in test mode without entering payment details.

Are there any fees?

Donatico itself is free and never adds a platform fee, on the free version or any paid Pro tier. Stripe charges its own standard processing fees (typically 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction in the US; see stripe.com/pricing for your country) – that’s the only fee involved.

How does Donatico’s pricing compare to GiveWP or other donation plugins?

Donatico charges $0 platform fee at every tier – free or Pro. That’s not universal in this space: GiveWP’s free plugin adds a 2% platform fee on Stripe donations unless you buy a paid license (plans start at $199/year, and recurring donations require a higher tier), and DonatoTomato charges a flat 1% fee on every donation processed. Donatico Pro, which unlocks recurring donations, starts at $49/year with no platform fee at any tier. See donatico.forgeo.dev for full pricing.

Can I migrate from GiveWP or Charitable?

Yes. Go to Donatico -> Import to bring in your donors, donation history, and campaign links from GiveWP or Charitable, or from a generic CSV export of any other system. A dry-run preview shows exactly what will be imported before anything is written to your database, and importing is duplicate-safe – running it more than once never creates duplicate donors or donations. Migration is available on the free version.

Can I accept recurring/monthly donations?

Yes – recurring donations are available in Donatico Pro, starting at $49/year. Supporters can give monthly or yearly through Stripe, with automatic renewal and a secure self-service portal to manage their subscription. The free version supports one-time donations. See donatico.forgeo.dev for Pro details.

What’s the difference between the free version and Pro?

The free version handles one-time donations with forms, goal tracking, multi-currency, offline/manual donation recording, fee recovery, an on-site donor history dashboard, migration tools (GiveWP, Charitable, CSV), donor receipts, a donation dashboard, a per-donation detail view, CSV export, Google Analytics 4 tracking, QR scan-to-donate codes, and a sticky donate button. Donatico Pro (Starter tier and up) adds recurring donations, fundraising campaigns (with countdown, milestone, and matching-challenge callouts included), donation tiers, full donor management, tribute gifts, a public donor wall, custom form fields, and a subscriber self-service portal. Donatico Business (a higher tier than Starter) additionally adds PDF donation receipts with sequential numbering, annual giving statements, your organization’s name/address/tax ID on receipts, outbound webhooks for connecting your own systems, fund/designation tracking, and tribute eCards. Learn more at donatico.forgeo.dev.

Can I use multiple donation forms on one page?

Yes. Each [donatico_form] shortcode renders an independent form with its own ID. Multiple forms on the same page work without conflict.

How do I test donations without real money?

Use Stripe test mode (enabled by default) and test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future expiry date and any CVC. No real charges are made.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin only collects data entered by the donor (name, email, optional message). Payment card details are entered directly on Stripe’s hosted page and never touch your server. See our Privacy Policy for Stripe’s data handling.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Donatico is a standalone plugin and does not require WooCommerce. It works alongside WooCommerce without conflict.

Can I customise the thank-you email?

Yes. Go to Donatico -> Settings -> Notifications to customise the subject line, heading, body copy (with merge tags), and footer. You can also send test emails from the same page.

What currencies are supported?

All major currencies supported by Stripe, including zero-decimal currencies like JPY and KRW, are supported. Set your currency under Donatico -> Settings.

Where is donation data stored?

All donation records are stored in your WordPress database in a custom wp_donatico_donations table. No data is sent to external servers other than Stripe for payment processing.
sections.changelog:
2.8.0

  • Add: on-site donation form via Stripe Elements, an alternative to the Stripe Checkout redirect – donors pay without leaving your page. Selectable in Donatico -> Settings -> Stripe; Checkout remains the default, so existing installs are unchanged.
  • Add: Apple Pay and Google Pay are supported in Elements mode too, after a one-time Payment Method Domain registration in your Stripe dashboard.
  • Fix: webhook handling hardened so a donation completes exactly once, regardless of which Stripe event type arrives or the order they arrive in.

2.7.0

  • Security: CSV export now neutralizes spreadsheet formula injection in donor-controlled fields.
  • Fix: annual giving statement queries now use an indexed date range instead of YEAR(), improving performance on large donation tables.
  • Add: configurable maximum donation amount (default $50,000) and stricter server-side currency validation on both one-time and recurring donation endpoints.
  • Add: abandoned pending donations older than 7 days are now cleaned up automatically via the daily cron.
  • Fix: PHP deprecation notice fired on every recurring donation, portal-link, and donor-dashboard-link request due to an incorrect REST validate_callback.

2.6.0

  • Add: Matching challenge campaigns (Donatico Pro) – set a matching ratio, sponsor name, and an optional cap on any campaign; the progress bar shows the sponsor-matched total alongside the raised total, capped once the sponsor’s commitment is reached.
  • Add: Tribute eCards (Donatico Business) – download a shareable PDF eCard for any tribute gift, showing the honoree’s name and message, from the donor dashboard.

2.5.0

  • Add: QR scan-to-donate codes – generate a QR code for any donation page URL from Donatico -> QR Codes, downloadable as PNG or SVG.
  • Add: Campaign countdown and milestone callouts (Donatico Pro) – campaign progress bars now show a countdown to the end date and milestone badges at 25/50/75/100% of goal, configurable from Settings -> Form.
  • Add: Sticky donate button – an optional, dismissible floating donate button on every page, with a configurable link and label.
  • Confirmed already shipped in a prior release: relative timestamps (“2 minutes ago”) on the recent-donors shortcode – no new work this release.

2.4.0

  • Add: Funds / designations (Donatico Business) – donors can choose which fund or program their gift supports from a dropdown on your donation form. A new Funds admin page shows per-fund totals raised, shown separately per currency for funds that received gifts in more than one. The designated fund also appears on donor receipts, the donor dashboard, the admin donation detail view, and CSV export.

2.3.0

  • Add: Google Analytics 4 donation tracking (free, all tiers) – set your Measurement ID under Donatico -> Settings -> Form -> Analytics and a donation event fires on the thank-you page with the correct amount and currency for every donation, including zero-decimal currencies like JPY.
  • Add: Outbound webhooks (Donatico Business) – register your own endpoint under Donatico -> Webhooks and subscribe to any of 5 events (donation completed, first donation from a donor, subscription created, subscription cancelled, campaign goal reached). Every delivery is HMAC-SHA256 signed, retried automatically up to 3 times on failure, and recorded in a delivery log with response codes and timestamps.

2.2.0

  • Add: Custom form fields (Donatico Pro) – add your own text, textarea, dropdown, checkbox, or hidden fields to your donation form under Donatico -> Custom Fields; values show on each donation’s detail view and in CSV export.
  • Add: Donation detail view – a “View” link on each row of the Donations list opens a read-only page with the donor, amount, status, payment method, and (when configured) custom field values for that donation.
  • Add: CSV export – a new “Export CSV” button on the Donations list downloads your full donation history, including any custom field values as extra columns.

2.1.0

  • Add: PDF donation receipts (Donatico Business) – a “Download PDF” link now appears alongside each receipt in the donor dashboard. Each receipt has its own sequential receipt number, separate from the internal donation ID.
  • Add: Annual giving statements (Donatico Business) – donors can download one PDF summarizing all of their donations for a calendar year, on-demand from the donor dashboard; totals are shown separately per currency for donors who gave in more than one.
  • Add: Organization name, address, and tax ID/EIN settings (Donatico Business) – optional fields printed on PDF receipts and annual giving statements.

2.0.1

  • Fix: The donor dashboard’s magic-link email could redirect to the homepage instead of the page containing the donor dashboard, even though the link itself worked correctly. The link now returns to whichever page the request was made from.

2.0.0

  • Add: Import donation history from GiveWP, Charitable, or a generic CSV file. Donors, donations, and campaign links are matched and imported in batches with a dry-run preview before anything is written, and re-running an import never creates duplicates.
  • Add: Import screen under Donatico -> Import shows detected sources, record counts, and a currency-mismatch warning when imported data does not match your site’s configured currency (amounts are always imported at face value; Donatico does not convert between currencies).
  • Fix: Fresh installs could fail to save any donation (“Unknown column” database error) because the donations table was missing columns added in earlier releases. New installs and updates now create the table correctly the first time.
  • Fix: Total Raised, Average Donation, goal progress, and Monthly Recurring Revenue could show an incorrect combined figure on sites with donations in more than one currency. These now show a correct total per currency, or count only the relevant currency toward a goal with other currencies noted separately.
  • Security: CSV file uploads are validated by file content (not just file extension) and stored outside any publicly accessible location.

1.8.1

  • Fix: Fresh installs could fail to save any donation (“Unknown column” database error) because the donations table was missing columns added in earlier releases. New installs and updates now create the table correctly the first time.

1.8.0

  • Add: Donor dashboard – donors can request a secure email link to view their own donation history and print receipts, no account required. Includes a “Manage Recurring” shortcut for subscribers.
  • Security: Donor dashboard links are single-use, rate-limited, and never reveal whether an email address has donation records.

1.7.0

  • Add: 42 supported currencies including zero-decimal currencies (JPY, KRW, VND, and more) with correct formatting and charge amounts everywhere.
  • Add: Fee recovery – optional “cover the processing fees” checkbox on donation forms so 100% of the intended gift goes to your cause (configurable percentage + fixed fee).
  • Add: Offline donations – record cash, check, and bank-transfer donations from a new Add Donation admin screen; they count toward totals and can send the same receipts as online gifts.
  • Fix: Recurring donation forms now apply fee recovery correctly and validate amounts server-side for every currency.

1.6.0

  • Fix: Failed recurring payments now trigger a dunning email to the donor with a secure link to update their card.
  • Fix: Dashboard and campaign totals now include recurring renewals going forward.
  • Fix: First recurring payment now also creates a donation record so initial charges appear in totals.
  • Security: New webhook event dedup table prevents duplicate processing on Stripe retries.

1.5.1

  • Add: Recurring donations feature preview for free users – see what Pro’s recurring giving offers.

1.5.0

  • Add: Secure customer portal – subscribers can manage their recurring donations via an emailed magic link ([donatico_customer_portal] shortcode).
  • Security: replaced unverified portal access with email-verified, single-use, time-limited token authentication.

1.4.0

  • Added: Subscriptions admin view – see all recurring donations (donor, amount, interval, status, Stripe subscription) with status filters and sorting.
  • Added: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Active Subscribers cards on the dashboard.

1.3.0

  • Added: Dismissable upgrade notice on Donations admin page
  • Added: Contextual upgrade prompt in Form Designer near frequency settings
  • Added: Locked Campaigns, Tiers, and Donors submenus with feature teaser pages when Pro is inactive
  • Added: SVG mockup previews on each teaser page showing what each feature looks like in Pro
  • All Phase 6B prompts gate on Pro presence – none show when Donatico Pro is installed and active

1.2.0

  • Added: In-admin Upgrade to Pro page with three-tier pricing comparison
  • Added: Freemius checkout integration for Starter, Business, and Agency plans
  • Added: “Get Pro” link on the WordPress Plugins admin page
  • All Pro upgrade prompts hide automatically when Donatico Pro is installed and active

1.1.1

  • Fix: Settings menu item now appears below all feature pages (Campaigns, Tiers, Donors) in the Donatico sidebar menu.

1.1.0

  • Add: donatico_donation_data_before_insert filter – allow plugins to inject extra column data when a donation row is created.
  • Add: donatico_checkout_session_metadata filter – allow plugins to inject additional metadata into Stripe Checkout sessions.
  • Add: Generic form field forwarding in form.js – inputs marked with data-donatico-extra="<key>" are automatically included in donation form submissions, enabling extension by add-on plugins.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Stripe Checkout integration with webhook handling
  • 3 form layouts: Inline, Stacked, Card
  • 5 shortcodes for forms and fundraising widgets
  • Admin dashboard with donation statistics
  • Donation list with status filters, search, and bulk delete
  • Form Designer with live preview
  • HTML email notifications for admin and donors with merge tag support
  • Customisable email templates via Settings
  • Multi-currency support: USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, INR, BDT
  • Anonymous donation option
  • Goal tracking with animated progress bar
  • Webhook handling: completed, expired, failed, refunded
  • Modern OOP architecture with PSR-4 autoloading via Composer
